zh-CN.title: 投稿回合协作
items: 投稿与审批现在按回合交接，当前编辑内容仅本方可见，提交后再完整同步
投稿入口只显示待处理投稿数，投稿列表的新内容统一使用小红点提示

en.title: Turn-based submissions
items: Authors and reviewers now hand submissions over in rounds, keeping current edits private until the next transition
The submissions tab now counts actionable submissions while list updates use a consistent dot indicator
